title: Assistant Lane Support SME - Remote
description:
Primary Mission:

The Assistant Lane Support Subject Matter Expert (SME) is an integral member of the West Virginia National Guard (WVNG) Ridge Runner Irregular Warfare Exercise (IWX) Program, responsible for supporting the planning, coordination, execution, and closeout of complex Special Operations Forces (SOF) training exercises. The position assists the Lane Support SME in coordinating logistics, manpower, resources, exercise infrastructure, and administrative requirements across assigned areas of operation.

The Assistant Lane Support SME must demonstrate strong organizational, logistical, asset deconfliction, and project management capabilities while supporting multiple exercises in various stages of development and execution. The position requires effective coordination with military personnel, Government agencies, civilian authorities, and domestic and international exercise participants in a dynamic, mission-driven environment.

Role and Responsibilities

• Provide operational, logistical, and administrative support to the WVNG Joint Staff Office, WVNG J37, WVNG J3 Joint Operations Center, and Ridge Runner Program in support of exercise planning, coordination, and execution.

• Assist the Lane Support SME with planning, development, coordination, and execution of Ridge Runner training activities, including Concept Development Conferences (CDC), Initial Planning Conferences (IPC), Mid Planning Conferences (MPC), Final Planning Conferences (FPC), and post-exercise closeout activities.

• Coordinate with domestic and foreign exercise participants, military organizations, Government agencies, and external stakeholders to synchronize exercise requirements, resources, schedules, and operational support.

• Support exercise lane development, site preparation, setup, execution, and recovery, including coordination with local business owners, municipal officials, and private landowners for access to facilities, infrastructure, and training locations through the Realistic Military Training (RMT) Packet process.

• Coordinate with federal, state, and local law enforcement agencies, emergency management organizations, and emergency medical services to support exercise integration, public safety, and operational requirements.

• Prepare and coordinate exercise notifications and required Memorandums of Understanding (MOUs) or Letters of Understanding (LOUs) with applicable jurisdictions, organizations, and property owners.

• Assist the Lane Support SME with exercise lane management, safety coordination, logistical support, personnel accountability, and resolution of operational or administrative issues during exercise execution.

• Support the coordination and delivery of Irregular Warfare training activities, instructional preparation, and exercise-related briefings in accordance with established Ridge Runner training objectives and program requirements.

• Perform administrative functions including event scheduling, calendar management, email and telephone correspondence, meeting coordination, note-taking, records maintenance, document organization, and tracking of assigned actions.

• Assist with coordination of foreign participant requirements, including foreign visit requests, installation access procedures, and communication with appropriate Government representatives when required.

• Maintain effective communication with Ridge Runner leadership, the Lane Support SME, exercise controllers, and participating organizations to identify emerging requirements, resolve coordination issues, and ensure continuity of exercise support.

Supervisory Responsibilities

• None

Required Qualifications and Education

•
Special Operations Experience: Minimum five (5) years of operational experience as an operator within a U.S. Special Operations organization, including USASOC, MARSOC, or NSWDG, with at least three (3) years of administrative or operational support to senior leaders in high-tempo or mission-driven environments.

title: Junior Category Manager
description:
About the role: What’s in the Box

You will join our European Strategic Sourcing Team, which buys the ingredients and products behind millions of HelloFresh meals across multiple markets. Our ambitious team is growing and we have several junior roles open within the Procurement team, each with its own focus.

You don’t need to pick a specific position upfront. During the process, we’ll get to know your strengths and interests and discuss together where you’d fit best. Whichever role you take, you’ll learn how international procurement works from start to finish and help make sure our customers get high-quality products at the right cost, every week.

Please note: For junior positions, we are unable to offer visa or work permit sponsorship, either now or in the future. To be considered, you must already have the legal right to work in your preferred location.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

• Support procurement strategies and plans across our European markets, working closely with experienced colleagues in the team.

• Analyse supplier offers, cost data and market prices to build cost models and spot savings opportunities.

• Monitor market trends and supply risks, using data and Generative AI tools to support pricing forecasts and decisions.

• Identify and assess suppliers, prepare negotiations and take ownership of selected suppliers as you gain experience.

• Collaborate with product, culinary, food safety and quality, and operations teams to bring new products to our customers on time.

• Contribute to cross-functional procurement projects and keep local and global stakeholders up to date on progress.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

• A bachelor’s or master’s degree, for example in business, supply chain, engineering, or food science.

• Up to 2 years of experience in procurement, supply chain or a related field. Exposure to the food industry is a plus.

• Strong analytical skills and confidence working with data in Excel or Google Sheets.

• Clear communication skills and the ability to build relationships with suppliers and colleagues across teams, countries and functions.

• A proactive, organised mindset. You take initiative and enjoy learning quickly in a fast-moving environment.

• Excellent English. Another European language is a plus, as is a willingness to travel occasionally within Europe.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. There are many different ways of developing skills, and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What we offer: The Toppings

Our benefits vary by country. Here is a taste of what you can expect:

• Tasty discounts : generous discounts on HelloFresh and our other brands, plus savings with partner brands.

• Learning & growth : internal training, and mentoring opportunities

• Flexibility : a hybrid working setup

• A warm welcome : an onboarding program and a dedicated manager

• Wellbeing : discounted fitness memberships and access to mental health and mindfulness apps.

• Financial security : a company pension scheme and commuting support, depending on your location.

• Great people : team events, Friday drinks and a lively office culture.

Are you the missing ingredient? If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you. We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

title: Senior Client Solutions Manager, Beauty - Influencer Marketing (Remote - US, EST hours)
description:

Own client relationships across launches, seasonal campaigns, and always-on programs. Multi-thread across teams. Build trust. Have direct conversations when performance needs to improve.

Translate data into clear, actionable plans. Present performance against KPIs (engagement, EMV, sales lift, affiliate impact) and explain what it means.

Manage timelines, scopes, budgets, and execution across seeding, paid, and integrated campaigns. Keep work on-brand, on-time, and within margin.

Manage renewal timelines. Identify upsell opportunities. Drive Net Revenue Retention. Be able to speak confidently about account growth with real numbers.

💾 Use Data to Improve What’s Next
Forecast performance. Optimize mid-campaign. Apply learnings to the next program. Reporting informs decisions - it’s not a recap.

🛡️ Keep the System Tight
Keep tracking clean. Watch team capacity. Fix what’s inefficient. Make sure client feedback doesn’t get lost.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

We’re looking for someone who has:

- Beauty Industry Background: Previous experience at a beauty brand, beauty retailer, or agency focused on beauty clients

- 4-6+ years in influencer or creator marketing

- Strong hands-on campaign experience, with real fluency in Meta and TikTok

- Clear track record of account growth and retention - bring numbers

- Experience measured against revenue, retention, or NRR KPIs

- Leadership experience (running 1:1s, managing workload, supporting team performance)
AI-native - integrating AI tools into your day-to-day work to drive faster execution, better insight, and smarter workflows.

- Beauty experience is a plus

- You should be commercially sharp, operationally reliable, and able to speak confidently about the revenue impact of the accounts you’ve managed.

TRAITS THAT MATTER

Curious. Commercially aware. Direct. Adaptable. Strong at building trust. Open to feedback. You don’t avoid hard conversations. You don’t wait for issues to escalate. You don’t need constant direction.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

6 months in: renewals are planned early, NRR targets are on track, expansion opportunities are clearly mapped, delivery runs smoothly, and leadership trusts your forecast.

BENEFITS

🌎 We’re a remote-first team, giving you the flexibility to work from wherever you do your best work
🌴 Annual Time Off: 25 days PTO + bank holidays, 4 company-wide days off (Kyra Days), 3 wellness days, and paid sick leave each year
📚 Growth: Annual Learning & Development budget to invest in your skills.
💰 Rewards: Annual bonus scheme to recognise great work
🩺 Healthcare coverage for US-based team members

AI is core to how we operate. Use it to elevate your work. But everything in your application should reflect your own judgement and experience.

If you have a condition or require an adjustment to our interview process - please let us know so we can make adjustments to support you. Please note that when you submit an application or resume, your data will be processed in line with our privacy policy https://www.bamboohr.com/legal

title: Senior Account Executive
description:
Location: Remote, anywhere in the US, occasional travel to our UK and Budapest offices

About Kodesage
Join Kodesage 's revolution to transform how enterprises understand, operate, and modernize their legacy systems. We're a growing team building an integrated service and AI-augmented legacy modernization platform, working on cutting-edge tech.
At Kodesage , you'll have freedom and flexibility in a passionate, seasoned team. We're looking for people who thrive on ownership and believe the best ideas win. If you're ready to make a real impact in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, we'd love to hear from you!
Why this role exists
Kodesage 's AI platform and its tailor-made solution for Oracle Forms migrations and production support are coming to the US. As our first Senior Account Executive in the US, you open the market: you win our first US customers and shape how we sell here.
What you'll do

• Win our first US enterprise customers for Oracle Forms migration and production support

• Own the full sales cycle, from qualified lead to signed contract

• Build the US pipeline and sales playbook with marketing, partners and our founders

• Work with Presales and Forward Deployed Engineers to grow each account after the first deal

What you bring

• You've sold or delivered Oracle projects, especially Oracle Forms, APEX or EBS. That's our one non-negotiable, and SaaS experience can't replace it

• Ideally you come from Oracle, or from an Oracle practice at a top-tier or boutique consultancy

• You know large consulting or systems-integrator environments, and you can sell a platform-led solution, not just services

• You've closed six-figure, long-cycle enterprise deals, keeping 5-10 stakeholders across IT, procurement and the C-suite moving

• You own a deal end to end: discovery, pipeline, negotiation, and growing the account after the first signature

Nice to have

• Sold migration, modernization or professional services into enterprises

• Partner and channel experience with system integrators or technology alliances

• Sold AI-powered products or developer tools to risk-averse buyers; a network among US enterprises running Oracle Forms

How we work

• Ownership: you run your deals end to end without needing to be managed

• Customer focus: you sell what solves their problem, not what's easiest to close

• Speed with structure: you move fast, keep the CRM current and forecast honestly

• Know the domain: you understand Oracle Forms and why enterprises modernize, because credibility wins trust

• Collaboration: you bring Presales, FDEs, marketing and founders in at the right time

The industry left legacy systems behind, but we didn't. Join a team decoding complex systems that even the best AI models can't crack on their own.

Our compensation takes into account the cost of labor in the different US markets we hire in. Where you land in the range depends on several factors, including location, job-related knowledge, skills and experience.
Pay Range
Base salary: $120,000 - $150,000
On-target earnings (OTE): $240,000 - $300,000

title: Head of Investor Relations
description:
We are hiring a Head of Investor Relations to lead the team that runs our investor network.
Pairs is a vetted private capital network. We put break-out founders in front of the family offices, VCs and strategic investors who fit them, and our team runs the investor relations work around every introduction. We are paid by the founder for our work, never by the round. Investors are members of the network and pay nothing. We are a small, senior team, profitable and self-funded.
The role
This is a leadership seat. You run the IR team: around six direct reports, the associates who each hold a book of members and clients. You report directly to the two co-founders.
Your job is to make that team excellent. You hire well, set a clear bar, run the weekly rhythm, coach every associate on their calls and pitches, and have the hard conversation early when someone is off track. The team’s results are your results.
Founders work with us for our investor network. Members read what we send because it fits what they told us. Through your team, you own that network and keep every relationship getting stronger month after month. You still take the mandate calls with our most senior family offices, because a leader who stays close to the work coaches it better.
What you will own

• The IR team: around six direct reports. Hiring, onboarding, weekly 1:1s, coaching, performance, and a clear bar for what good looks like.

• The team’s rhythm: a weekly kickoff, a weekly review of every win and loss, and a team that runs on its own when you are not in the room.

• The health of the investor network: more active members every month, and every member getting deals that fit their thesis at the pace they asked for.

• Pitch quality: every introduction your team sends is one you would put your own name on.

• A weekly read on the numbers to the co-founders: mandate calls, activations, pitches, founder calls and referrals.

• Senior mandate calls with family offices and strategic investors, including new regions.

• Close work with our client success team, so every client’s raise keeps moving.

You are a fit if you

• Have run a team before, ideally around six direct reports, and can show what they achieved under you and who you grew.

• Have hired, coached and, when needed, let go of people, and held a team to a standard without doing their work for them.

• Have 6 or more years on the investment side of a family office, VC or growth fund, or in capital raising for private companies.

• Hold real, current relationships with family offices, and know what they ask before they take a founder call.

• Write a two-line pitch an investor reads to the end.

• Run on systems: CRM discipline, a clear weekly rhythm, nothing left in your head.

• Treat discretion as a reflex: founders’ numbers and members’ names stay confidential.

• Work like it is 2026: AI tooling runs the admin so your hours go to people.

What we offer
US$200K to US$300K total compensation. Fully remote, with a few hours of overlap with US Eastern time. A seat reporting directly to both co-founders, a team to lead, and a network that grows with every month you put into it.
How to apply: hit apply, which takes you to a short application form. We read every application. Please do not name investors or companies from past roles anywhere in it.
Compensation Range: $200K - $300K

About Pyka
Pyka’s goal is to provide society with a new form of safe, clean, and cost-effective transportation enabled by autonomous electric aviation.
To get there, we’re taking a different approach than most. We're applying our technologies to every industry where autonomous electric aircraft can be useful, starting with the highest value and most dangerous jobs. In doing so, we're building game-changing products manufactured at scale, while perfecting the safety, reliability, and capabilities of our autonomy engine and electric propulsion systems. 
We design, develop and manufacture an ecosystem of technologies including proprietary flight control software, avionics, high power density motors, motor controllers, batteries, and custom carbon-fiber composite airframes.
Today, we supply autonomous electric aircraft for cargo transport and crop protection to real-world customers across four separate continents and have secured industry-first regulatory approvals from the FAA. Our cargo aircraft enables remote connectivity, enhances express delivery networks, and ensures fast and reliable shipping of critical supplies to areas in need. Our crop protection aircraft offers agricultural services providers and farmers an autonomous tool to make aerial application safer, more precise, and less harmful to surrounding environments. Both vehicles are highly economical to operate, easy to deploy, and significantly reduce CO2 emissions in their respective industries. 
What you work on at Pyka makes people’s lives better now and brings the future of electric aviation one step closer each day. 

Role Overview
Pyka is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to be the software owner of our Dropship and Cargo programs. The software problems in these programs span the stack: path planning over long ranges, controls for a new airframe, integration of new sensors, engine control and state-of-charge management on a hybrid powertrain, and incorporating weather into how a mission is planned and flown. You will be responsible for the software behavior of these aircraft as a whole - what it needs to do, how the pieces fit together, and whether it is ready to fly - and you will be the engineer the Dropship team comes to when software is the open question on their side.
 
Some of the current and future projects you will likely contribute to include:
Path planning for long-range cargo missions that accounts for energy state, winds aloft, and weather along the route
Energy management on a hybrid powertrain: engine control, state-of-charge policy, and how the aircraft trades power against range, payload, and reserve
Flight controls and handling for a new airframe, from simulation through flight test
Integrating new sensors and payload systems, and defining the software needs before the hardware is fixed
Turning operational feedback from cargo flights into requirements for the next iteration of the aircraft
Defining what mission planning and ground tools need to expose to operators flying these aircraft

Export Control Requirements

description:
About Deploy
 
Deploy is an intelligence infrastructure platform that gives developers and enterprises access to open source and proprietary AI models. For leading open source LLMs, Deploy operates an optimized model inference engine that keeps costs and latency low while maintaining high throughout.  Deploy also offers a set of proprietary AI models that address challenges in content safety, AI & deepfake detection, sponsorship intelligence, and IP & publicity protection. Trusted by the world's largest and most innovative organizations, Deploy's solutions unlock high-performance AI model inference at production scale.

Deploy has raised more than $200M from leading investors, including Tomales Bay Capital, General Catalyst, 8VC, Glynn Capital, Bain & Company, Visa Ventures, and others. The company has more than 250 employees across offices in San Francisco, Seattle, New York, and Delhi.
 
UI / UX Designer Role
 
You’ll be expected to own your space: work with all disciplines on your team to build, launch and iterate. You will work closely with the product team to conceptualize and execute on designs to solve problems for our products. This is a very rare opportunity that will put you in the position of total ownership of whole product from design perspective without the risk of starting your own company. Every designer at Deploy has responsibility of a whole product, although we encourage the team to provide feedback to each other.
 
You are a talented designer who consistently delivers visuals and interactions of highest quality on timelines that would be unrealistic for many others. You take pride in your creative vision, execution and communication skills. You are a strong individual contributor, but also a team player. You enjoy taking ownership of full products, and are stifled by large design organizations.
 
You get a rush from seeing your designs live in the real world.

Who We Are 
 
We are a group of ambitious individuals who are passionate about creating a revolutionary AI company. At Deploy, you will have a steep learning curve and an opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest growing AI start-ups in San Francisco. The work you do here will have a noticeable and direct impact on the development of the company. Thank you for your interest in Deploy and we hope to meet you soon!
 
The current expected base salary for this position ranges from $60,000 - $100,000. And you won't stop at the concept: you'll design algorithms, implement them in our embedded Rust firmware and validate them on real hardware. You'll work closely with, and report into, the Senior Manager for NEMEA. You're shaping how the team operates, not running it solo. Think of this as a high-impact individual contributor role with a leadership layer built in: the natural next step for an ADR who's ready to start making other people better, not just themselves.

Our NEMEA team is already strong. Driven, independent, hitting their numbers. What they need isn't more oversight. They need someone who sharpens how the team works, especially around process and tooling, while making sure newer reps get the support to ramp fast.

Contribute to the wider GTM motion. You'll keep strong alignment with your AE partners and take part in pipe review cadences. You'll support the Senior Manager in preparing performance updates and regional insights, and join bi-weekly RD cadences where it makes sense.

title: People Operations Lead (Fixed term Contract)
description:
ABOUT FLOCK

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we're changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK's leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We're growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we're hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We're on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll own the people engine room at Flock: the employee lifecycle, payroll input, benefits, the HRIS, the office and our in-person events. Your job is to design how a modern People function should work at a company where repetitive admin is automated out of existence and every process is simple, scalable and AI-native by default. You'll report to our Senior People Partner and work with everyone here, from a new joiner on day one to the CEO, who cares deeply about our culture. Please note this role is a 12-18 month fixed term contract.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

People Operations

- Own the full employee lifecycle: contracts, right-to-work, starter and leaver logistics, probations and changes. Shape the first day and first week alongside managers, delivering a strong employee experience across the lifecycle.

- Be the first point of contact for people queries and audits. Own the People inbox and core HR templates, and drive every query to resolution.

- Own the HRIS (HiBob) and people data: records, workflows, surveys and data integrity. Deliver monthly People reporting and metrics that spot and close gaps early.

- Own payroll input end to end: collate, calculate and submit each month, including bonuses and comp changes. Manage the provider and partner with Finance on reporting and year-end.

- Own benefits end to end as the main contact for providers, systems, data and employee advice, keeping policies and materials current.

- Cut manual effort across the lifecycle by building AI-native workflows, so every routine people process is automated by default, then coach the business to use them. Own continuous improvement across People Ops.

- Partner with IT on joiner and leaver access automation, and on cost and data audits.

Office Management & Socials

- Run the office environment and vendor relationships, including routine upkeep like weekly snack orders and post. Cover health and safety as a trained First Aider and Fire Marshal, and provision hardware fast.

- Own the company social calendar and rituals, from bi-weekly Flock o'Clock (working closely with the CEO) to quarterly Town Halls and larger events, keeping them engaging and on budget.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- Hands-on People or HR Operations experience, ideally in a fast-moving scale-up, with real ownership of end-to-end processes. CIPD or equivalent experience required.

- Hands-on payroll input and benefits administration. HiBob experience is a plus.

- Strong HRIS skills across workflows, automations and integrations, plus confident data and spreadsheet ability.

- Real evidence of building with AI: workflows or tools you've shipped and use, not ones you've only read about.

- Exceptional organisation and judgement. You spot what needs doing and get ahead of it, you build the credibility that lets you influence without leaning on authority, and you treat confidential matters with discretion.

- A quick, first-principles learner who is comfortable with pace, ambiguity and autonomy.

- Working knowledge of UK employment law, compliance and people governance.

- Low ego and high standards. You care most that the work is right and well run.

You will lead Fraud Operations' response to audit and regulatory observations, and you will help Mercury get ready to operate as a bank, translating what examiners and partner banks expect into the processes, evidence, and documentation our teams need every day.

You don't need to be the deepest domain expert in every fraud typology. You need to be able to hold your own in an incident, ask the right questions, bring the right people in, and turn a messy channel full of data into a clear, defensible, and actionable narrative. You'll work closely with Fraud Investigations and Enablement, Risk Strategy, Compliance, Legal, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering.

What You'll Do

Lead fraud incident management

• Spot patterns across incidents and turn them into durable fixes in alerts, rules, SOPs, product or tooling change requests, and training instead of one-off responses.

Write the memos and responses partners and auditors rely on

• Draft incident and retro memos for bank partners and internal risk governance: what happened, impact, root cause, controls in place, remediation plan, and timelines.

• Prepare accurate, concise responses to partner-bank questions, suspicious activity and investigation inquiries, and requests for information.

• Track open partner requests, commitments, and change-management items, and make sure Fraud Operations responds consistently and on time.

title: Redwood Finance Automation Engineer, Romania
description:
Redwood Finance Automation Engineer, Romania
Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Romania. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.
The programme
An established organisation is automating its finance operations on Redwood Finance Automation. The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, account reconciliation, journal processing and the reporting that follows, all connected to the organisation's ERP.
You will build what the solution design sets out. You will configure the close and reconciliation processes, build the integrations with the ERP and the systems around it, and carry each process through testing, go-live and early support.
What you will work on
Close processes built and configured end to end: task lists, dependencies, approvals and the automated steps between them. Automated account reconciliation, including matching rules and exception handling. Journal entry automation, from data preparation and validation through to posting in the ERP. Integration with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and other source systems, through standard connectors, file and API interfaces. Intercompany, accrual and reclassification steps automated alongside the close. Workflow logic in REL or JavaScript where the standard designer does not meet the requirement. Unit and integration testing, defect fixing, and support through user acceptance testing. Promotion between environments, cutover and hypercare. Technical documentation and handover to the support team.
What you bring
Hands-on delivery on Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance), where you built close, reconciliation or journal processes yourself on at least one live implementation. 5 or more years in finance systems or automation engineering. Working knowledge of SAP FI/CO postings and master data, or the Oracle equivalent, and where ERP integrations tend to break. Workflow scripting in REL or JavaScript, and hands-on ERP integration. A finance-side understanding of the record-to-report cycle and month-end controls.
Useful but not essential:
Redwood RunMyJobs workload automation. BlackLine, Trintech, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. A current Redwood certification. Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.
How to respond
Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood implementation: the finance processes in scope, the ERP it connected to, and what you built yourself.

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood Finance Automation people in front of the client.

Upwind is a next-generation Cloud Security Platform that leverages runtime context to identify and prioritize critical risks, providing precise insights and efficient cloud security management. Unlike traditional tools, Upwind uses runtime data proactively for risk prioritization and posture insights, ensuring teams focus on what truly matters. With industry-leading efficiency and eBPF-powered sensors, Upwind delivers comprehensive capabilities, including agentless cloud posture discovery, real-time threat protection, and integrated API security. • Curiosity, problem-solving mindset, and a genuine personal interest in security beyond the day job.

• B.Sc. in Computer Science / Information Security - an advantage.

• Ensure tasks and updates in the system are completed and followed through.

📦 Vendor & Procurement Support

• Communicate with vendors to request pricing and confirm deliveries.

• Support coordination of material deliveries to job sites.

• Maintain updated vendor records and basic procurement tracking.

title: Product Communications Manager

Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

Plaid's Communications team tells the story of how our products work and why they matter. This role focuses specifically on fraud and risk: you'll build the media relationships, write the content, and shape the messaging that establishes Plaid as a leader in modern fraud prevention.

You've done this kind of work before in fintech, security, or a similar technical space, and you know how to turn a complex product into a story a reporter or customer actually wants to read. - Track and complete submissions for key industry awards

- 10+ years in tech, fintech, fraud, and/or cybersecurity communications

- Strong writing skills - you can take a complex or technical topic and make it clear and interesting to a non-expert reader

- Real, hands-on media relations experience: you've built reporter relationships and secured coverage yourself, not just through an agency

- Strong program and project management skills - you can run multiple things at once without a lot of oversight

title: Head of Strategic Relations - Australia
description:
Company Overview

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service - spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack - from the lab to the field - we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.

 

Group Overview

Metrea is actively building its presence in Australia as part of a deliberate, globally coordinated expansion into the Asia-Pacific region. Our Asia-Pacific Market Group, headquartered in Brisbane with an additional office in Perth, is the enterprise's dedicated regional interface connecting Australia's national security community with Metrea's full suite of capabilities across three core domains: Aerospace, Electromagnetic & Cyber, and Digital & Synthetic. Metrea is now bringing that same depth of mission expertise and proven operating model to Australia.

Underpinning these capabilities is a global network of Support Groups spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement; ensuring that as we grow in Australia, we do so with the full weight of an established global enterprise behind us.

Metrea's solutions are built for elegance: effective, efficient, and evolving; enabling our partners to scale capacity and achieve asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats. 

Position Summary

As Head of Strategic Relations - Australia, you will lead Metrea’s engagement with federal and state governments across defence, national security and emergency management. You will build trusted relationships with key decision-makers, with a particular focus on Home Affairs, the Australian Border Force and the Australian Defence Force. Through ongoing engagement and contributions to legislative and policy development, you will help identify and shape new business opportunities, while anticipating and managing risks to existing programs.
 
As a senior member of the Asia-Pacific Market Group, you will turn insights into Australia’s policy and government priorities into practical advice that informs Metrea’s strategy and growth. Your primary focus will be Australia, with opportunities to support engagement across the broader region and contribute to the global enterprise as required.

What You'll Do

• Lead Metrea’s Australian government engagement strategy, building trusted relationships with senior policymakers, public servants and operational leaders across federal, state and territory governments

• Develop a clear understanding of key decision-makers and priorities across Defence, Home Affairs, the Australian Border Force, policing, Foreign Affairs and related national security port

About the role

Quotient is seeking an experienced, detail-oriented operational leader to run the management, process control, governance and quality leadership of its research tissue bank. Quotient's human tissue bank is the foundation of our proprietary high-resolution somatic genetics platform, which delivers insights into cellular and organ disease biology and discovers novel targets for the development of new medicines.

This role combines ownership of the tissue bank with practical oversight of delivery. Key responsibilities

• Biobank governance and strategy: Own Quotient's research tissue bank strategy, aligning governance, capacity, resources and operating systems with the research portfolio, and recommend investment and improvements. title: Tabular AI Solution Architect
description:
The role
You are the technical voice of Probabl in front of US data science teams: the person who takes a first conversation to a technical discovery, a demo on their own problem and a scoped proof of concept, alongside the sales team. Services owns technical pre-sales and delivery; you bring that field engineering expertise to the sales team on every US opportunity.
Probabl is the Tabular AI company founded by the creators of scikit-learn. Skore, our platform, builds, validates and tracks predictive models on tabular data with the methodology of the scikit-learn maintainers built in. Data science is being rewritten by agents faster than the discipline can absorb it; our job is to keep the science guarding the speed.
This is our first Solution Architect in the US. You join the Services team, Probabl 's applied AI team of field engineers and solution architects, and work day to day with our US sales lead. Our pre-sales practice already runs in France, with a Solution Architect, a reference demo, a demo kit and a PoC playbook. You run it for the American market and feed back what you learn, so the whole team's practice gets better.
What you'll do

• Run the demo. Own the reference Skore demo for the US and adapt it to a prospect's use case in days, with the demo kit, on your own.

• Run technical discovery. With data science leads and their platform teams: current stack and tooling, how models are built and validated today, where reliability leaks, what a first project would look like.

• Scope the PoC. Turn a qualified opportunity into one scoped question on the customer's data, with a clear go/no-go, then hand it to our field engineers to deliver.

• Run workshops and hackathons. Hands-on sessions with a prospect's data science team on their own data, and the occasional hackathon with partners or schools: the fastest way to show what Skore does and to qualify a team.

• Answer the hard questions. Architecture, security, deployment options (on-prem, BYOC, cloud), how Skore fits an existing stack. You bring Engineering in when needed, not by default.

• 5+ years in data science or ML engineering, then pre-sales or solutions work for a data or AI product. You have built models in production and you have sold the idea of building them better.

• You master tabular data work end to end, whatever the framework: scikit-learn of course, but just as much gradient boosting, PyTorch, time series and the like, with the evaluation and validation that go with them. You can read a prospect's pipeline, spot the leakage, and show them in a notebook what a sound evaluation looks like.

• You run a room. A live demo to 20 data scientists, a whiteboard with a platform team, a discovery call with a VP: you adjust and you land the point.

• You are comfortable with enterprise buying groups: data science, IT and security, procurement, and the economic buyer, each with their own question.

• Based in the US, remote, with travel to customers and periodic trips to Paris.

title: Staff Product Designer
description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at  www.coreweave.com .

 

We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

 

About Physical AI

CoreWeave's Physical AI team helps companies apply AI to the physical systems they design, test, and operate, across automotive, industrial, robotics, and autonomous vehicles (AV).

We work as one cross-functional team of product, design, engineering, and forward-deployed engineers, partnering directly with our customers' engineering teams.

Our focus is twofold: making AI usable for engineers who know their machines in depth but are not ML specialists, and supporting robotics and AV teams across the full development loop, from sensor data and simulation to model training and evaluation.

What You’ll Do:

As a Staff Product Designer on the Physical AI team, you will lead design across our portfolio of Physical AI products, turning complex data and ML workflows into tools that engineers who build vehicles, machines, and robots trust and use every day. You'll bring strong design craft and sharp product judgment to a new product area, setting direction and framing ambiguous problems.

This is a role with real breadth. You'll own the end-to-end experience across a number of products, from the customer-facing apps engineers use day to day to the builder tools our Field team use to create and publish those apps. You'll set a shared design vision for the portfolio and consolidate our Physical AI products into the broader CoreWeave design language, so they reuse proven patterns and feel like part of one platform. You'll also spend time with customer engineering teams to understand their workflows, data, and constraints, turning what you learn into clear problem framing for Product and Engineering.

We're looking for a designer who uses AI tools as a core part of their workflow today, to prototype, test ideas, and explore more options in less time. Comfort with technical complexity and a bias toward experimentation are essential here.

As the most senior designer on the Physical AI team, you'll mentor the designers you work alongside, raise the craft bar, and shape how design works with Product, Engineering, and Field Engineering. You'll be joining a small, high-trust design team. The work is broad, the impact is real, and there's room to shape how design operates at one of the fastest-growing infrastructure companies in the world.

Who You Are:

• 8+ years of experience as a versatile designer who can own all facets of design, including user research, UX, interaction design, prototyping, and UI design.

• An excellent portfolio showcasing user-centered problem solving through interaction design, visual design, and systems thinking.

• Deep proficiency with Figma and a solid understanding of building usable, accessible, and modular designs that scale.

• Experience partnering with Product and Engineering to define strategy and solve complex problems for technical users in B2B, infrastructure, developer tools, or platform contexts.

• Actively incorporates AI tools into your design workflow, using them to move faster, prototype smarter, and tackle harder problems.

• Comfortable working with technical complexity and ambiguity; you help teams frame problems, not just resolve them.

Preferred:
